text: いろいろな　ボタンを　よくつかう　じゅんばんで　せつめい　します。

structure.jp: いろいろな　ボタンを
よくつかう　じゅんばんで
structure.en: in the order of most used

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: よくつかう　じゅんばん
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing word tells you what kind of thing it is. よくつかう　じゅんばん = 'the order of how often you use them'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a word tells you the way something is done. じゅんばんで = 'in order'.

patterns.name: 〜する
patterns.explanation: する added to an action word turns it into a verb. せつめい　します = 'I will explain'.
